description: This file defines the PerformanceTrackerDecorator class which provides additional methods to manipulate and access PerformanceTracker entities, including setting related Employee entities and formatting date fields.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class that adds utility methods to the PerformanceTracker entity, such as setting employee references and formatting dates.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with a PerformanceTracker entity.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee associated with the performance tracker using an employee number.

methods.name: setAddedByByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the 'added by' employee for the performance tracker using an employee number.

methods.name: getAddedDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted date when the performance tracker was added.

methods.name: getModifiedDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted date when the performance tracker was last modified.
